cards.ex: The two runners were neck and neck right up to the finish line.
cards.exUz: Ikki yuguruvchi finish chizig'igacha tengma-teng edi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada deyarli bir xil natija ko'rsatish, juda yaqin.

cards.ex: You need to stay ahead of the competition by innovating constantly.
cards.exUz: Doimiy ravishda yangiliklar yaratish orqali raqobatdan o'zib ketishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan yaxshiroq bo'lishga harakat qilish, oldinda qolish.

cards.ex: I was going to suggest that, but you beat me to it!
cards.exUz: Men buni taklif qilmoqchi edim, lekin sen mendan oldinroq qilding!
cards.uzDef: Birov bir ishni qilishdan oldin qilib qo'yish.

cards.ex: They've raised the stakes by offering a huge bonus to the winner.
cards.exUz: Ular g'olibga katta mukofot taklif qilib, xatarni oshirdilar.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatni kuchaytirish, talablarni oshirish.

cards.ex: The software industry is known for its cutthroat competition.
cards.exUz: Dasturiy ta'minot sanoati shafqatsiz raqobati bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va murosasiz raqobat.

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yinni o'zgartiruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan yangilik yoki voqea.

cards.ex: It was a nip and tuck race, with both cars battling for the lead.
cards.exUz: Bu juda yaqin poyga edi, ikkala mashina ham peshqadamlik uchun kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin bo'lgan raqobat yoki musobaqa.

cards.ex: The lawyers were out for blood during the trial.
cards.exUz: Advokatlar sud jarayonida g'alaba qozonish uchun juda qattiq kurashayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun juda qattiq kurashayotgan odam.

cards.ex: Studying hard will help you gain an edge in the exam.
cards.exUz: Qattiq o'qish imtihonda ustunlikka erishishingizga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda ustunlik beradigan afzallikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: After the first round, she's still in the running for the championship.
cards.exUz: Birinchi raunddan keyin u hali ham chempionat uchun imkoniyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha korxonalar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng imkoniyatlar mavjud bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He's always trying to one-up me with his achievements.
cards.exUz: U doimo o'z yutuqlari bilan mendan o'zib ketishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovdan ko'ra yaxshiroq ekanligini ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Smaller companies are nipping at the heels of the market leader.
cards.exUz: Kichik kompaniyalar bozor yetakchisining ortidan quvmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Birovni yaqindan ta'qib qilish yoki bosim o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The project failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun qayta boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yechimini topish uchun yangidan boshlash.

cards.ex: He managed to edge out his opponent in the final round.
cards.exUz: U so'nggi raundda raqibini siqib chiqarishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina farq bilan yutish yoki siqib chiqarish.

cards.ex: It's a dog eat dog world in the business.
cards.exUz: Bu biznesda vahshiyona raqobat.
cards.uzDef: Hamma o'zi uchun kurashadigan shafqatsiz raqobat.

cards.ex: The company has thrown down the gauntlet to its rivals by launching a new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulotni ishga tushirish orqali raqiblariga kurashga chorladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga qarshi kurashga tayyor ekanligini e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: The startup leapfrogged its competitors by offering a better service.
cards.exUz: Startap yaxshiroq xizmatni taklif qilib, raqobatchilaridan o'tib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlardan yoki kompaniyalardan tezroq o'sish va o'zib ketish.

cards.ex: There's stiff competition for jobs in this industry.
cards.exUz: Ushbu sohada ish topish uchun qattiq raqobat mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va qiyin raqobat.

cards.ex: The two teams will battle it out for the championship title.
cards.exUz: Ikki jamoa chempionlik unvoni uchun kurashadi.
cards.uzDef: Yakuniy natijani aniqlash uchun qattiq kurashish.

cards.ex: The company is playing hardball in negotiations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya muzokaralarda qattiq o'ynamoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun qattiq va murosasiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: Having experience in the field gives you a head start.
cards.exUz: Sohada tajribaga ega bo'lish sizga dastlabki ustunlik beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga nisbatan boshida ega bo'lgan afzallik.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi texnologiyalar bilan birga bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan bir xil darajada qolish, orqada qolmaslik.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, they came out on top in the end.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, ular oxirida g'olib chiqishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish, g'olib bo'lish.

cards.ex: They managed to get the upper hand in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ular muzokaralarda ustunlikni qo'lga kiritishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovdan ustunlikka ega bo'lish, vaziyatni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: The new product has raised the bar for the entire industry.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot butun sanoat uchun talabni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni yuqoriroq darajaga ko'tarish.

cards.ex: The other companies are eyeing up our market share.
cards.exUz: Boshqa kompaniyalar bizning bozor ulushimizga ko'z tikmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Birovning mulkiga yoki lavozimiga ko'z tikmoq.

cards.ex: It's a race against time to finish the project before the deadline.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muddatdan oldin tugatish vaqtga qarshi kurash.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun tezda harakat qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: She was nervous, but she held her own in the debate.
cards.exUz: U hayajonlangan edi, lekin u bahsda o'z o'rnini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yaxshi ish qilish, o'z o'rnini yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: The competition keeps us on our toes.
cards.exUz: Raqobat bizni hushyor tutadi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni hushyor va tayyor holatda saqlamoq.
